geraldo.manual.abertura: Everything the $(item)Pasture$() does on this server: the work area, the drop farm, the berries, the bees, breeding (Cobbreeding) and the Pokémon-powered multiblocks.$(br2)Lost the book? Book + hay bale in a crafting table.
geraldo.manual.basico.modos.p1: The $(l)block under$() the Pasture picks what it does:$(li)$(item)Bone block$(): $(thing)drop farm$().$(li)$(l)Anything else$(): only type jobs (furnaces, harvesting...), without filling the chest with drops.$(br2)Swapped the block? The mode changes by itself within a few seconds.
geraldo.manual.basico.modos.p2: $(l)Type jobs$() (Jobs chapter) work in $(l)every$() mode: a Fire Pokémon on the farm still heats nearby furnaces.$(br2)To keep the chest tidy, use one Pasture per purpose.
geraldo.manual.basico.area.p1: Pasture Pokémon roam a $(l)9x9$() area $(l)in front of you$(): place the Pasture on the edge of the pen, $(thing)facing inside$(). A green message confirms it.
geraldo.manual.basico.area.p2: $(li)The Pasture sits in the middle of one side; the area goes 9 blocks forward and 4 to each side.$(li)Up to $(l)16$() Pokémon per Pasture and at most 4 Pastures per chunk.$(li)Pastures placed before the update keep the old area: break and place them again.$(li)Pastured Pokémon take no damage.
geraldo.manual.basico.drops.p1: With a $(item)bone block$() under the Pasture, every $(l)5 minutes$() each Pokémon produces $(thing)its species drops$() (the same as defeating a wild one) and carries them to a chest.
geraldo.manual.basico.drops.p2: $(li)The chest must be within $(l)8 blocks$() of the Pasture (5 high).$(li)Full chest: the Pokémon waits up to 10 min, then drops the items on the ground.$(li)Legendaries, mythicals and Ultra Beasts only produce drops in the $(l)Legendary Sanctuary$().$(li)At night they sleep and stop, unless fed a $(item)Chesto$() berry.$(li)Want it faster? See the $(l)Pokémon Ranch$() under Multiblocks.
geraldo.manual.basico.drops.extras: Some Pokémon drop Minecraft mob items (farm only, not when defeating wild ones):$(li)$(l)Mismagius$(): glowstone dust and bottle$(li)$(l)Rowlet, Decidueye$(): arrows$(li)$(l)Copperajah$(): copper  $(l)Gholdengo$(): gold$(li)$(l)Lumineon$(): tropical fish  $(l)Torterra$(): seagrass and bowl$(li)$(l)Wooloo, Dubwool$(): wool in the $(l)color they were dyed$() (use a dye on them)$(br2)Pre-evolutions drop them too, at lower chances.
geraldo.manual.basico.drops.extras2: Items from $(l)Nether, End and special$() mobs drop $(l)only in the Ranch and Sanctuary$() (mid and late game):$(li)Blaze rod (Magmar), breeze rod (Whimsicott), ghast tear (Drifblim)$(li)Magma cream (Magcargo, Camerupt), froglights (frogs)$(li)Shulker shell (Shuckle), totem (Cofagrigus), wither skull (Marowak)$(li)Sculk catalyst (Dusknoir), saddle (Mudsdale), sponge (Corsola), Tide template (Relicanth), ominous bottle (Honchkrow)
geraldo.manual.basico.drops.3d.texto: Bone block under the Pasture and a chest nearby.
geraldo.manual.basico.comandos.pokemax: $(l)/pokemax <slot> [level]$(): maxes the Pokémon in that party slot (1-6): level (no number = 100), IVs 31, EVs 252 on the best attack + 252 speed + 6 HP, friendship 255 and a full heal.$(br2)$(l)/pokemax all [level]$(): the same for the whole party.$(br2)E.g. $(l)/pokemax 1$(), $(l)/pokemax 2 50$() or $(l)/pokemax all$(). Requires op.
geraldo.manual.basico.comandos.modoteste: $(l)/modoteste$(): shows what is on.$(li)$(l)/modoteste loot on|off$(): drop farm every 10 s.$(li)$(l)/modoteste ovo on|off$(): Cobbreeding egg every ~10 s.$(li)$(l)/modoteste on|off$(): everything at once.$(br2)Saved in the world. Requires op.
geraldo.manual.basico.noite.p1: On this server $(l)no Minecraft mobs spawn$(): no zombie, creeper or cow. Their drops come from Pokémon (Drop Farm, Ranch). Villagers, the trader and golems still appear.$(br2)In exchange, $(thing)at night$() some wild Pokémon turn $(l)aggressive$(): they chase and hit you, and can kill you.
geraldo.manual.basico.noite.p2: $(li)Aggressive: $(l)Dark, Ghost, Poison and Dragon$() types and brawlers like Gyarados, Ursaring, Mankey, Scyther, Rhydon and Tauros.$(li)Damage grows with the Pokémon’s level.$(li)You can hit and kill them (normal drops).$(li)In the $(l)Nether and the End$() it is always night.$(li)Legendaries, owned and Pasture Pokémon never attack.$(li)The Ars $(item)Ritual of Sanctuary$() stops them spawning near your base.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.como.p1: Besides drops, pastured Pokémon do $(l)jobs$() based on their $(thing)type$(), moves or ability, using the blocks around them.$(br2)$(li)Blocks must be within $(l)8 blocks$() of the Pasture (5 high).$(li)Whatever they collect goes into a $(l)chest$() in that same range.$(li)A Pokémon does every job it can at the same time.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.como.p2: Pokémon only walk inside the 9x9 area, but they $(l)reach$() blocks up to 8 away from the Pasture: crops, furnaces and cauldrons can sit just outside the pen.$(br2)$(thing)Water$() jobs need water inside the area for the Pokémon to swim in.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.colheita.p1: Harvest when ripe and leave it replanted:$(li)$(l)Grass$(): crops, berries, sweet berries, galarica, hearty grains, revival herb, vivichoke, leek$(li)$(l)Bug$(): apricorns$(li)$(l)Fairy$(): mints$(li)$(l)Ghost$(): nether wart
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.colheita.p2: $(li)$(l)Rock$(): amethyst clusters$(li)$(l)Steel$(): tumblestones (regular, sky and black); the bud grows back$(li)$(l)Combee/Vespiquen$(): fill beehives and collect honey when full$(li)$(l)Water$(): keeps farmland moist
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.maquinas.p1: $(li)$(l)Fire$(): fuels furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers that have items — no coal needed!$(li)$(l)Dragon$(): fuels brewing stands.$(li)Empty cauldrons become: $(l)lava$() (Fire), $(l)water$() (Water) or $(l)powder snow$() (Ice), every 90 s.$(li)$(l)Water$(): puts out nearby fire.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.abelhas.p1: Bee Pokémon in a Pasture with a $(item)Beehive$() or $(item)Bee Nest$() within $(l)8 blocks$() make honey: $(l)Beedrill, Combee, Vespiquen, Cutiefly and Ribombee$().
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.abelhas.p2: $(li)Every $(l)2 min$() each bee fills the hive by 1 level (full = 5).$(li)When the hive is full, a bee harvests it into the chest: $(l)1-3 honeycombs$(), a $(l)50%$() chance of a $(item)Honey Bottle$() and $(l)15%$() of a $(item)Honey Block$().$(li)$(thing)Vespiquen$() is the queen: $(l)2-4 honeycombs$(), $(l)80%$() for 1-2 bottles and $(l)35%$() for a block.$(br2)Works in any Pasture mode. More hives = more honey.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.abelhas.3d.text: Beehive (or nest) and a chest near the Pasture. The bees bring everything to the chest.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.abelhas.dicas: $(li)The $(item)Beehive$() is craftable (planks + honeycombs); the $(item)Bee Nest$() comes from trees.$(li)Minecraft bees in the same hive also fill it: both help.$(li)Honeycomb becomes a $(item)Honey Bottle$(): 3 combs + 1 bottle in a crafting table.$(li)A full chest stops the harvest: empty it with a hopper or pipe.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.crescimen: The Ars $(item)Ritual of Overgrowth$() works on Cobblemon plants: berries, mints, apricorns, leeks and the rest. It reaches 5 blocks around, only at the brazier’s height (1 above and 1 below).
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.captura: Only $(l)wild, regular$() Pokémon can be trapped:$(li)$(item)Soul Gem$() (Occultism): doesn’t work on legendaries, mythicals, Ultra Beasts or owned Pokémon.$(li)Ars $(item)Mob Jar$() (Ritual of Containment): if it catches one of those, it is released in ~2 s.$(br2)Owned Pokémon stay in their owner’s party/PC: nobody can steal anyone’s Pokémon.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.sacrifici: Occultism $(item)rituals$() that ask for a sacrifice accept an $(l)equivalent Pokémon$() you kill within 8 blocks of the ritual:$(li)Chicken: Pidgey, Starly, Fletchling...  Pig: Tepig, Lechonk, Spoink$(li)Cow: Miltank, Tauros  Sheep: Wooloo, Mareep  Horse: Ponyta, Mudbray$(li)Fish: Magikarp, Goldeen  Squid: Tentacool  Bat: Zubat  Spider: Spinarak

$(li)Human: Machop, Timburr, Jynx, Mr. Mime$(li)Iron golem: Golett  snow golem: Snorunt$(li)Enderman: Abra  Slime: Grimer, Goomy  Zombie: Yamask$(li)Bee: Combee  Parrot: Chatot  Goat/llama: Skiddo  Camel: Numel  Armadillo: Sandshrew$(li)Rare: Warden = Dusknoir, Ravager = Rhydon, Shulker = Shuckle, Vex = Misdreavus
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.fertilida: The $(item)Ritual of Fertility$() gives the $(l)Feast$() (every work effect for 60 min, like the enchanted golden apple) to Pasture Pokémon within $(l)5 blocks$() of the brazier. It renews by itself when an effect is missing; it uses source like the ritual.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.invocacao: The $(item)Ritual of Animal Summoning$() summons $(l)common wild Pokémon of the biome$() (level 5 to 25) instead of animals: Snorunt in snow, Sandshrew in desert, Wingull at sea, Geodude in mountains...
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.desintegr: The $(item)Ritual of Disintegration$() undoes $(l)aggressive$() wild Pokémon within 6 blocks (the ones that attack at night) and drops $(item)Experience Gems$(); it uses source each time. No drops.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.rocket: The $(item)Ritual of Challenge$() (in a village) calls $(l)Team Rocket$() instead of pillagers: grunts and, in strong raids (Emerald in the ritual), admins. $(l)Talk to them to battle$(); win for rewards.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.santuario: The $(item)Ritual of Sanctuary$() also stops $(l)wild$() Pokémon from spawning in its area (32 blocks, up to 128 with rotten flesh). Great to protect your base and farms.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.drygmy: The Ars $(item)Drygmy$() collects the $(thing)species drops$() of wild Pokémon near it or trapped in a $(item)Mob Jar$(): the same as the Pasture (without the machine-only items).
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.drygmy2: $(li)Legendaries, mythicals and Ultra Beasts give nothing (and can’t be trapped).$(li)Pasture Pokémon don’t count for the Drygmy: they already produce through the Pasture or the machines.$(li)Actually killing Pokémon still only gives the normal drops (the rule only applies to the Drygmy and the Battlefield).$(br2)For bigger, faster farms, see the $(l)Pokémon Ranch$() under Multiblocks.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.magia.battlefie: The Occultism $(item)Dimensional Battlefield$() works too: trap a regular wild Pokémon in a $(item)Soul Gem$() and it gives its $(thing)species drops$() (the same as the Pasture). Legendaries can’t go in, because the Gem won’t hold them.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.p1: A $(l)Miltank$() in a Pasture fills the nearest $(item)tank$() with $(thing)milk$(): Create tank, Immersive barrel and the like, within $(l)8 blocks$() of the Pasture (5 high). The goats $(l)Skiddo$() and $(l)Gogoat$() give milk too, just less.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.p2: Every $(l)30 s$(), each one adds to the tank:$(li)$(l)Miltank$(): 125 mB (1 bucket every 4 min)$(li)$(l)Gogoat$(): 50 mB$(li)$(l)Skiddo$(): 25 mB$(br2)A $(item)Salac$() berry $(l)doubles$() it. Works in any Pasture mode. Full tank: that cycle’s milk is lost. Use the milk with Create (a Spout fills buckets) or in recipes that need milk.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.lava: The same way, $(l)Magby, Magmar, Magmortar, Slugma and Magcargo$() fill the nearest tank (one that holds lava, like Create’s) with $(thing)lava$(). Every 30 s: Magby and Slugma 50 mB, Magmar 100, Magcargo 125, Magmortar 200. Salac doubles it.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.3d.texto: A tank near the Pasture. The chest is only needed if you also use the drop farm.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.jarra: $(item)Miltank in a Jar$() (Cooking for Blockheads): like the cow, drop an $(item)anvil$() on a $(l)Miltank$() standing on a $(item)Milk Jar$(). The jar becomes a milk source for the kitchen.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.leite.jarra2: $(li)Wild Miltank: it becomes the jar.$(li)Your own Miltank: it $(l)leaves your party/PC$() and becomes the jar; you must be within $(l)16 blocks$().$(li)Someone else’s Miltank without its owner nearby: nothing happens.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.movimentos.fogo: $(l)Fire$()-type Pokémon in a Pasture keep the Create $(item)Blaze Burner$() $(l)lit$() within $(l)8 blocks$() of the Pasture. With the move $(thing)Flame Charge$(), they make it $(l)superheated$().

$(li)Each Fire Pokémon looks after up to $(l)2$() Blaze Burners.$(li)Just $(l)one$() of them knowing Flame Charge makes every burner of that Pasture superheated.$(li)Works in any Pasture mode, even with no block underneath.$(li)It costs nothing: as if it added coal (or a Blaze Cake) when the fire is running low.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.movimentos.folh: A Pokémon that knows $(thing)Magical Leaf$() in a Pasture makes $(l)crops$() within $(l)8 blocks$() grow faster, like the Ars Growth Ritual: every 10 s each plant has a $(l)25%$() chance to grow as with bone meal.

$(li)Works on crops, saplings, berries, apricorns, mints and the other Cobblemon plants, cocoa and berry bushes.$(li)It doesn’t spread grass or flowers.$(li)Pair it with a harvesting Pokémon in the same Pasture and the farm runs by itself.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.estabulo.p1: $(l)Psychic and Fairy$()-type Pokémon in a Pasture fill the nearest $(item)Source Jar$() (within 8 blocks) with $(thing)source$(). Every 10 s each adds $(l)half its level$() (level 50 = 25). Salac doubles it.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.estabulo.3d.tex: A Source Jar near the Pasture. Full jar: the extra is lost.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.altar.p1: $(l)Ghost$()-type Pokémon in a Pasture with an Occultism $(item)Sacrificial Bowl$() nearby visit it and bring $(thing)otherworldly things$() to the chest, every 5 min each.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.altar.p2: It can bring:$(li)Otherworld Ashes, Datura, Purified Ink (common)$(li)Cursed Honey, Demon’s Dream Essence, Otherworld Essence$(li)Spirit Attuned Crystal (rare), Awakened Feather (very rare)
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.altar.3d.texto: A Sacrificial Bowl and a chest near the Pasture.
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.tesouros.p1: $(li)$(l)Psychic$(): picks up items on the ground.$(li)$(l)Poison$(): turns arrows on the ground into poison arrows.$(li)$(l)Ground$(): digs dirt, gravel or mud and finds ores, bones and $(thing)fossils$() (every 4 min).$(li)$(l)Water$() while swimming: fishes (every 90 s).
geraldo.manual.trabalhos.tesouros.p2: $(li)Move $(l)Dive$() while swimming: deep treasure (gems, Water Stone, balls).$(li)Ability $(l)Pickup$(): finds random items (balls, candies, stones, healing items) every 3.5 min.$(li)Healing moves ($(thing)Wish, Recover, Roost, Synthesis, Rest$()...): give nearby players regeneration.$(li)$(l)Slowpoke$(): makes it rain (every 10 min).
geraldo.manual.frutas.frutas.p0: Right-click a pastured Pokémon with the berry: uses 1 berry and the effect lasts $(l)20 minutes$().$(br2)Different effects $(l)stack$(); giving the same berry again refreshes the timer. Looking at the Pokémon, $(thing)Jade$() shows the effects and time left.
geraldo.manual.frutas.frutas.salac: $(l)Swift$(): the Pokémon works double (produces drops twice).
geraldo.manual.frutas.frutas.lansat: $(l)Luck$(): an extra roll of the rare drops only, with tripled chance.
geraldo.manual.frutas.frutas.sitrus: $(l)Plenty$(): an extra roll with doubled amounts.
geraldo.manual.frutas.frutas.chesto: $(l)Insomnia$(): the Pokémon stays awake and keeps working at night.
geraldo.manual.frutas.banquete.p1: The $(item)Enchanted Golden Apple$() gives $(l)all 4 effects for 60 minutes$(). It never shortens an effect that already lasts longer.
geraldo.manual.frutas.banquete.p2: Only made in the Ars Nouveau $(thing)Enchanting Apparatus$(): $(item)Golden Apple$() in the middle, $(l)8 gold blocks$() on the pedestals and 2000 Source.
geraldo.manual.frutas.cocho.p1: A $(item)Feeding Trough$() with berries within $(l)8 blocks$() of the Pasture (4 high) feeds that Pasture's Pokémon by itself.
geraldo.manual.frutas.cocho.p2: $(li)Checks every 10 s and feeds anyone missing the effect or with less than 1 min left.$(li)Use one trough per berry you want to keep up.$(li)Trough with enchanted apples: only used if some effect is still missing after the berries.
geraldo.manual.reproducao.cobbreeding.p1: Open the Pasture and click the $(thing)Toggle breeding$() button to turn breeding on there. It works in $(l)any mode$() (drop farm or jobs only).
geraldo.manual.reproducao.cobbreeding.p2: Like in the games:$(li)$(l)male + female$() sharing an $(thing)egg group$(), or $(l)Ditto$() + anything$(li)the $(thing)Undiscovered$() group (legendaries etc.) never breeds$(li)the baby is the most basic form of the $(l)mother’s$() species$(li)one egg every $(l)~7 to 12 min$() per Pasture
geraldo.manual.reproducao.cobbreeding.p3: $(li)$(item)Destiny Knot$() on a parent: the baby inherits $(l)5 IVs$().$(li)$(item)Everstone$(): passes down the holder’s $(l)nature$().$(li)$(l)Hidden ability$(): the baby can get it even if the parents don’t have it.$(li)$(l)Shiny$(): parents from different trainers make it $(l)4x$() more common (Masuda Method).$(li)Eggs stay $(l)in the Pasture$() (up to 5): when it is full, no more eggs.
geraldo.manual.reproducao.ovos.p1: Hover over the egg: it shows the $(l)species$(), $(l)IVs$(), nature, a $(thing)gold star$() if it is $(l)shiny$() and a marker if it has $(l)perfect IVs$().
geraldo.manual.reproducao.ovos.p2: Carry the egg in your $(l)inventory$() and it hatches by itself; the baby joins your party (or PC).$(li)Time: $(l)30 s per egg cycle$() of the species. E.g. Magikarp ~2.5 min, Pikachu ~5 min, starters ~10 min.$(li)A Pokémon with $(thing)Flame Body$(), $(thing)Magma Armor$() or $(thing)Steam Engine$() in your party hatches eggs $(l)2x$() faster.
geraldo.manual.reproducao.automacao.p1: $(l)Pulling eggs out$(): hopper, pipe (Pipez), Create funnel/belt, Modular Routers... on $(l)any side$() of the Pasture, both halves. It is $(l)take only$(): nothing goes into the Pasture that way.$(br2)This way the Pasture never fills up and keeps laying.
geraldo.manual.reproducao.automacao.cloc: In an Immersive $(item)Garden Cloche$(): $(l)hay bale$() as soil and the $(l)egg in the seed slot$(). It needs power, like any crop.
geraldo.manual.reproducao.automacao.p3: $(li)In $(l)~4 min$() (any species) the egg comes out $(l)ready$() from the Cloche.$(li)A ready egg $(l)hatches instantly$() when a player picks it up: the baby goes to that player’s party or PC.$(li)Full line: Pasture → pipe → Cloche → pipe → chest. Then just grab the ready eggs from the chest.$(li)The Cloche keeps working while you are away if the chunk is loaded (FTB Chunks).
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.p1: A tower that turns Pokémon electricity into $(thing)energy (FE)$(): it powers the Create $(item)Electric Motor$() and Immersive Engineering machines.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.funcion: Put $(l)Electric$()-type Pokémon in the $(item)Pasture$() inside the tower (it is a cage around it).$(br2)The $(thing)power$() of the tower is the $(l)sum of their levels$(). It checks every 5 s: if the Pokémon leave the Pasture, it stops.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.energia: $(li)Power 1+: $(l)64 FE/t$()$(li)Power 100+: $(l)128 FE/t$()$(li)Power 200+: $(l)256 FE/t$()$(li)Power 400+: $(l)512 FE/t$()$(br2)E.g. 8 Electric Pokémon at level 50 = power 400. Stopped? Open the controller: it tells you what is missing.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.3d.text: Electric tower with caution stripes, Tesla coils and lightning rods (9x9x5). Button: preview in the world. Or let the controller build it (Auto Build).
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.materia: $(li)1 $(item)Pasture$() (the machine’s Pokémon live in it)$(li)36 $(item)Brass Casing (Create)$()$(li)20 $(item)Yellow Caution Block (TFMG)$()$(li)18 $(item)Steel Scaffolding (IE)$()$(li)13 $(item)Brass Illumination Casing (Create Prism)$()$(li)8 $(item)Copper Coil Block (IE)$()$(li)4 $(item)Accumulator (Create Crafts & Additions)$()$(li)4 $(item)Lightning Rod$()$(li)4 $(item)Tesla Coil (Create Crafts & Additions)$()$(li)3 $(item)Yellow Inverted Illumar Lamp (ProjectRed)$()$(li)3 $(item)Yellow Inverted Fallout Light (ProjectRed)$()$(li)2 $(item)Electrum Block (Create Crafts & Additions)$()

$(li)$(item)Controller$(): layer 2, front center$(li)Energy Output (MMR): layer 2, back center$(li)$(item)Pasture$(): layer 2, middle center$(br2)Layer 1 = the bottom one. Front = the controller side. In the 3D view, the $(item)Lodestone$() marks the controller spot.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.torre.receita: Thunder Stone, Source Gems (Ars) and an Electronic Component (Immersive).
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.p1: $(l)Rock$()-type Pokémon dig for you: the mine produces $(thing)ores$() of everything that spawns in this server’s world. Pokémon with $(l)Rock Smash$(), $(l)Dig$(), $(l)Super Luck$() or $(l)Pickup$() add $(l)enchantments$() (see further on).
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.funciona: Put $(l)Rock$()-type Pokémon in the $(item)Pasture$() inside the quarry and plug $(thing)energy$() into the input (a $(l)Pika Tower$() works).$(br2)Its $(thing)power$() is the $(l)sum of the levels$() of the Rock Pokémon. Every $(l)20 s$() it rolls ores into the item output.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.enc_toqu: Does any Pokémon in the machine’s $(item)Pasture$() know the move $(l)Rock Smash$()?$(br2)Then it outputs the $(l)ore block$() (more yield when crushed). Without it, the ore comes out already broken (raw iron, diamond, redstone dust...).
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.enc_fort: Each Pokémon in the $(item)Pasture$() with the $(l)ability$() $(l)Super Luck$() or $(l)Pickup$() gives $(l)+1 roll$() per cycle (up to $(l)+3$()).$(br2)E.g. Pickup: Meowth, Zigzagoon, Aipom, Munchlax. Super Luck: Absol, Murkrow, Togepi.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.enc_dig: Each Pokémon in the $(item)Pasture$() that knows the move $(l)Dig$() makes the cycle $(l)50% faster$() (up to $(l)2x$(), with 2 Pokémon).$(br2)Enchantments work with $(l)any Pokémon$() in the Pasture, not only Rock ones.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.faixas: More $(thing)power$() means more rolls per cycle and rarer ores. The next pages show the $(l)chance of each roll$() in each tier.$(br2)The list shows the ore; without $(l)Silk Touch$() it comes out already broken (raw iron, diamond...).$(br2)Stopped? Open the controller: it shows if it lacks power, energy or output space.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.mina.faixa1.0: Power $(l)1+$(): $(l)1$() roll(s) every 20 s (~180/hour), uses $(l)32 FE/t$().$(br)$(li)Coal: 22%$(li)Iron: 18%$(li)Copper: 18%$(li)Tin: 11%$(li)Zinc: 11%$(li)Lead: 8.8%$(li)Salt: 5.9%$(li)Sulfur: 4.4%

geraldo.manual.multiblocos.rancho.p1: The drop farm upgrade: the Ranch is a corral with the $(item)Pasture$() inside, and produces each one’s $(thing)species drops$() $(l)5x faster$() than the Pasture.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.rancho.funcio: $(li)Counts the Pokémon in the $(item)Pasture$() inside the corral (up to $(l)16$()).$(li)Every $(l)60 s$(): $(l)1 roll$() of each one’s drop table.$(li)Uses $(l)128 FE/t$() (a Pika Tower handles it).$(li)Drops go to the $(item)item output$(); whatever doesn’t fit pops out on top of the controller.$(li)Works at night too.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.rancho.regras: $(li)Drops are the $(l)Drop Farm$() ones $(l)plus$() Nether, End and special mob items (blaze rod, totem...).$(li)Berries work: $(item)Salac$() = extra roll, $(item)Lansat$() = extra roll of rare drops only, $(item)Sitrus$() = extra roll with doubled amounts.$(li)A Pokémon counted by the machine $(l)doesn’t drop through the Pasture$(): one or the other.$(li)Legendaries, mythicals and Ultra Beasts don’t count here: only in the $(l)Legendary Sanctuary$().

geraldo.manual.multiblocos.pecas.p1: MMR only has recipes for the $(l)Tiny and Small$() energy inputs/outputs (up to 512 FE/t). Bigger ones are $(l)upgrades$() of the previous one (8 materials around):$(li)$(l)Normal$() (512 FE/t): Small + copper wire coils + copper plates$(li)$(l)Reinforced$() (2,048): Normal + electrum wire coils + steel plates$(li)$(l)Big$() (8,192): Reinforced + HV Coils + Brass Casings$(li)$(l)Huge$() (32,768): Big + netherite + Advanced Components
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.montagem.p1: No need to place it block by block: put the $(item)controller$() where you want the machine (it is the $(l)front$()), open it and go to the $(thing)structure$() tab. It has a $(l)place structure$() button.
geraldo.manual.multiblocos.montagem.p2: $(li)It asks $(l)with or without modifiers$(): pick $(l)without$() (machines here don’t use them).$(li)Blocks come from $(l)your inventory$(): carry all the materials (each machine’s Materials page has the list). Missing one? It tells you which.$(li)Wrong blocks in the way are $(l)replaced$() by the right ones.$(li)MMR inputs/outputs also come from your inventory: bring the ones the machine needs.$(li)The $(item)Pasture$() is part of the machine: bring $(l)1 Pasture$() too. Then just put the Pokémon in it.$(li)In creative it builds for free.
